A123365.name: Values of k such that A046530(k) = (k+2)/3, where A046530(k) is the number of distinct residues of cubes mod k.
comment: Conjecture: With the exception of the first term a(1)=1, this is exactly the sequence of primes of the form 6k+1 (A002476). This has been verified up to a(n)=2000.
link: R. J. Mathar, Table of n, a(n) for n = 1..10000

A123722.name: Values of n for which A000224(n)=Ceiling[(n+1)/3]; A000224(n) is the number of squares mod n.
comment: Conjecture. If n>2 and a(n) is a multiple of 3, then a(n)/3 is a prime; further, all odd primes are given as a(n)/3 for some n. (This has been verified up to n=2000.)
A123722.author: _John W. Layman_, Oct 09 2006

A123723.name: Values of n for which A000224(n)=Ceiling[(n+1)/4], where A000224(n) is the number of squares mod n.
comment: Conjecture. If n>4 and a(n) is a multiple of 4, then a(n)/4 is a prime. (This has been verified up to n = 2000.)
